study type: secondary analysis of a prospective observational cohort study
exposure: transcervical Foley catheter placement for cervical ripening
cohort: Women with a history of ≤2 low-transverse cesarean deliveries who underwent induction of labor at ≥24 weeks of gestational age with a live singleton fetus without major anomalies
finding: Transcervical Foley catheter placement for cervical ripening was not associated with an increased risk of uterine rupture or uterine scar dehiscence in women undergoing induction of labor after prior cesarean.
